descriptionChirho: Body, the physical form of a person or being; an Aramaic noun (geshem) used in Daniel (Dan 3:27–28, 4:30, 5:21, 7:11) for the corporeal body, attested with singular and plural pronominal suffixes. English 'his body/their bodies', Spanish 'su cuerpo/sobre sus cuerpos', Hindi उसका शरीर/उनके शरीरों, Arabic جَسَدُهُ/أَجْسَادِهِمْ, Korean 몸이/몸들을, Swahili 'mwili wake/miili yao'. Singular and plural possessive forms express the same core meaning of physical body.
